summary: John's 5th-great-grand-aunt; wife of Sheriff Stephen Van Loon.
bio: Daughter of Thomas Lamoreaux (named in his will); married Stephen Van Loon, Luzerne County sheriff from 1816 and a militia captain of the War of 1812 era. Their probable son Samuel Van Loon (1811-1885) was sheriff from 1859.
sources: WikiTree Lamoreaux-21 (Thomas Lamoreaux; full will transcription citing FamilySearch images of Luzerne Will Book A): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Lamoreaux-21 ; PAGenWeb will transcription: http://www.pagenweb.org/~luzerne/patk/tomlam.htm

Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.356-358
